description.name: Entry
description.text:
Weakness Damage +30% to party, Cap Break Level 1, Zenith Mimicry Dance & Ultimate Mode to user
Ultimate Spirit Mode: En-Fire/Ice/Wind/Earth Damage +20%, Physical/Magic Casting Speed x1.1 & chases a Fire/Ice/Wind/Earth ability with Lv.2 En-Fire/Ice/Wind/Earth Stack; After ally uses Fire, Ice, Wind or Earth abilities, grants Fire, Ice, Wind or Earth Ability Damage +30% for 1 turn to that ally, +Quick ATB 1 under Mystery Mode (max 3 chases)
Ultimate Dexterity Mode: Dualcast Fire/Ice/Wind/Earth, Higher Multiplier & Zero Hone Cost to Hero Ability; Magical Mimicry+: Higher multiplier & Cap Break Level 1 after 3 uses
Ultimate Vitality Mode: +1500 max HP & Astra to user
Zenith Mimicry Dance: [Single-target DEF/RES/MND -70%] or [MAG/MND +25% & DEF/RES +30% to party and Mystery Mode to user] with at least 0/4 Fate Synergy members
